app.title: Tip
app.subtitle: Private Tip & Gift Card on Zcash
app.tagline: Send a private gift. Pick an amount, add a message, share one link.

sender.howMuch: How much would you like to send?
sender.feeNote: Network fee: 0.0001 ZEC. This goes to the Zcash network, not to us.
sender.moneySafe: Your money is safe. Nothing has been lost.
sender.safeSharingNote: Anyone with this link can claim the gift. Share it only with the person you mean.
sender.passcodeHint: The receiver will need this passcode to open the envelope.

receiver.addressPlaceholder: Paste your Zcash address (u1... or zs1...)
receiver.cannotUndo: You can't undo this after sending.
receiver.delivering: 0.05 ZEC is on its way to your wallet ending
receiver.passcodePrompt: Enter the passcode set by the sender to claim this gift:

errors.underfunded: We received less ZEC than needed. Send the remaining amount to finish your gift.
errors.notFoundYet: We haven't seen your payment yet. It may still be on its way. Your money is safe. Check your wallet's history.
errors.earlyOpen: This gift is being secured. Try again in a few minutes. We'll keep checking.
errors.alreadyClaimed: This gift has already been claimed. If this wasn't you, ask the sender to check who they shared it with.
errors.invalidAddress: That doesn't look like a Zcash address. Check that it starts with u1 or zs1, or scan the QR code.
errors.transparentBlocked: This is a public address. Using it would show the amount to everyone. Please use a private (shielded) address.
errors.wrongNetwork: This address is for a test network. Use a normal Zcash address.
errors.offline: You're offline. We'll finish when you reconnect. Nothing has been sent yet.
errors.linkTruncated: This link looks incomplete. Ask the sender to share it again.
errors.wrongPasscode: That passcode doesn't match. Check with the sender. 3 tries left.
errors.noWasm: This browser can't open private gifts. Try Chrome or Safari.
errors.serverUnreachable: We can't reach the Zcash network right now. Your gift is safe. We'll retry.
